A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Koloi ya segagabi, shale ya pikoko, leungo le le nayang botshelo la mmoki: dimpho tse di tumileng thata tsa bareki di lebega di sa dire, mme ke yone ntlha ya bone. A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Ledi la tshipi la Chera le le mo kokoanyong ya Musiamo wa Napier, kwa Thiruvananthapuram. Madi a tshipi a Chera a na le bora le motsu, letshwao la losika lwa segosi, mme dikai tse dintsi tsa ntlha di tswa kwa Karur, e leng bogare jwa Chera mo Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Kgosana ya losika lwa Ay kwa nageng e e kwa borwa ya dithaba ya Ba-Podiyil (Pothigai). Ngwao e e itsegeng thata e bolela ka go neela ga gagwe modimo mongwe seaparo se se botlhokwa, se gantsi se bidiwang Shiva — go neela jaaka boineelo mmogo le bopelotshweu.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Kgosana ya losika lwa Malaiyaman, ya naga e e dikologileng Mullur le Tirukkoyilur, o ne a gakologelwa ka bopelonomi jwa gagwe mo baboking le mo go botlhe ba ba neng ba tla kwa go ene. Sebaka sa gagwe mo gare ga batshegetsi ba ba supa se bontsha gore tlotlo ya mmusi e ne e lekanngwa ka go aba ga gagwe fela jaaka ka tshimo ya gagwe.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Ledi la tshipi la Chola le le tshotseng letshwao la segosi la Pandya. Fa ba Chola ba ne ba tlisa naga ya Pandya ka fa tlase ga puso ya bone, ba ne ba baya tlhapi ya Pandya fa thoko ga nkwe ya bone — letshwao la phenyo le le iteilweng mo tshiping.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Motse o dibuka, tshegetso ya segosi, bodumedi le botshelo jwa toropo di kopaneng mo go one dingwaga di ka nna dikete di le pedi.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Ledi la tshipi la Kulottunga Chola le le nang le sereto sa “Malai Nadu konda Chola” — Ba-Chola ba ba tsereng naga ya dithaba, ke gore, lefatshe la Ba-Chera. A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Ledi la tshipi la ga Kulottunga I (1070–1120 C.E.), yo o neng a kopanya mela ya Chola le Chalukya Botlhaba mme a busa nngwe ya dipuso tse ditelele le tse di atlegileng thata tsa Chola. Madi a gagwe a tshipi a tswelela ka mefuta e e tlhomilweng ya Chola e e nang le leina la gagwe ka Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Madi a tshipi a ga Rajaraja I. Madi a gagwe a tshipi a kopore a mofuta wa kgosi e e emeng le ya setshwantsho se se ntseng, a a neng a tlhagisiwa morago ga gore a fenye bokone jwa Sri Lanka, a ne a aname thata mo matlhakoreng oobedi a lewatle mme a ne a etsisiwa ka makgolokgolo a dingwaga.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Ledi la tshipi la bogosi jwa Jaffna le le bontshang pitse e e nang le ditlhapi. Dikgosi tsa Tamil tsa Jaffna (makgolo a bo13–17 a dingwaga) di ne tsa ntsha madi a tshipi ka ngwao ya India Borwa, e leng segopotso sa dikamano tse di gaufi go kgabaganya Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Madi a tshipi a Kongu Cheras, mola wa Chera o o neng o busa naga ya Kongu ya kgaolo ya bophirima ya Tamil (go dikologa Coimbatore, Erode le Karur ya gompieno) — yona kgaolo e e ntshitseng dithotobolo tse di humileng tsa madi a tshipi a Roma.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Setshwantsho se se rweleng serwalatlhogo, se se nang le ditedu mo porofaeleng, se apere baki e e nang le mabenyane le dikhafo tse di elelang, se tsholetsa thobane e e nang le dintlha tsa masiba. Sefatlhego le diatla di thadilwe ka mola o mosesane o montsho mo mmung o o bosetlha mme diaparo di tlhatswitswe ka ochre, pinki le botala — thuto e e tshwanang le setshwantsho sa moaparo wa segosi mo setshwantshong sa tempele.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Ntlha ya siling e e pentilweng ya lefelo le le boitshepo la logaga lwa Ba-Jain kwa Sittanavasal: di- lotus tse di pinki tse di bulegang mo gare ga di- pad tse ditala, phologolo e e tsamayang mo metsing le setshwantsho se se phuthang malomo. A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Sejana sa phitlho se se tswang mo dithabeng tsa phitlho tsa dithaba tsa Nilgiri, sekhurumetso sa sone se rwele serwalatlhogo sa ditshwantsho tse di tshwantsheditsweng. Baepi ba lekgolo la dingwaga la bolesomerobongwe ba di-cairns tsa Nilgiri ba ne ba fitlhela dikhurumelo tse dintsi tse di ntseng jalo tse di neng di na le batho, diphologolo le bapagami — ditshwantsho tse dinnye mo letsopeng tse di ka bontshang botshelo le maemo a baswi.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Garland ya ditemana di ka nna lekgolo le masome a matlhano tsa akam ka Kanimethaviyar, di ka nna masome a mararo tsa nngwe le nngwe ya diponagalo tse tlhano tsa naga.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Ledi la tshipi la gauta la ga Rajaraja I (985–1014 C.E.), moagi wa tempele e kgolo kwa Thanjavur. E bontsha letshwao la segosi la bogologolo la Chola: nkwe e e ntseng e dikologilwe ke ditlhapi tse pedi tsa Pandya, ka fa tlase ga parasol ya bolaodi, ka leina la kgosi ka Nagari — Chola e bolela gore e busa borwa.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Halofo ya kahavanu ya gauta ya ga Virajendra Chola (1063–1070 C.E.). Kahavanu (go tswa mo kahapana) e ne e le lekoko la gauta la Sri Lanka, mme gauta ya Chola e e iteilweng go fitlha kwa maemong ano e bontsha nako ya puso ya ga Chola mo setlhaketlhakeng.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Leboko le le kaelang la Di-Idyll tse di Lesome ka Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar. Motho yo o nang le yazh e kgolo o kaelwa kwa go Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan wa Kanchi; mo tseleng leboko le penta ditiragalo tse di tlhamaletseng tsa metse, boemakepe le batho.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Leboko le le kaelang la Dipolelo tse di Lesome ka Mudathama Kanniyar. Moletsi wa meropa (porunar) yo o duetsweng thata o kaela moletsi ka ene kwa kgosing e e pelotshweu ya Chola e bong Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Leboko le le kaelang la Dipina Tse di Lesome ka Nallur Nathathanar. Moopedi yo o tshamekang yazh (harepa) e nnye o gogela yo mongwe kwa kgosing Nalliyakkodan, a tlhalosa mathata a baopedi ba ba humanegileng le bothitho jwa motshegetsi yo o pelotshweu.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Leboko le le kaelang la Di-Idyll tse di Lesome ka Perunkausikanar. Badiragatsi ba ba kgarakgatshegang (koothar) ba kaelwa kwa kgosing Nannan; leboko le ketekiwa ka ntlha ya go tshwara medumo e mentsi ya dithaba.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Nkho e kgolo ya polokelo e amanang le Adichanallur. A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Leboko la Di-Idyll tse Lesome ka Nakkeerar. Ka nako ya phefo e telele e e tsididi ya bokone ya mariga, kgosigadi e tlhologelelwa monna wa yone fa kgosi e ntse e tlhokomela masole a yone a a gobetseng kwa kampeng ya ntwa.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Ledi la tshipi le le nang le setshwantsho sa kgosi ya Chera e bong Kuttuvan Kotai, le le mo nayang leina ka Se-Tamil-Se-Brahmi. A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Kasu ya selefera ya mofuta wa “Uttama”, e e boletsweng fano ke Rajendra I. The Koorainadu saree is associated with: Saree ya Koorainadu e amana le Koorainadu gaufi le Mayiladuthurai kwa Tamil Nadu. E amana haholo-holo le diaparo tsa lenyalo tsa setso le bohlokwa ba setso ba matsela meetlong ya lenyalo la Se-Tamil. Mefuta ya setso e akaretsa matsela a silika le a silika-letseta, ka ditlhamo tse di farologaneng le didiriswa tse di dirisiwang go ya ka setaele le maikaelelo a a rileng. Saree e bontsha seabe sa diaparo tse di logilweng mo meletlong ya botlhokwa ya lelapa le phetiso ya dingwao tsa masela magareng ga dikokomana. Ponagalo ya yone, letsela le dikarolo tsa yone tsa mokgabiso di ka farologana, ka jalo dikai ka bongwe di tshwanetse go kwalwa go ya ka kago ya tsone ya mmatota go na le go tsaya gore saree nngwe le nngwe ya Koorainadu e latela moakanyetso o o tshwanang. Ngwaga o o tlhomameng wa tshimologo ya ngwao eno ga o ise o tlhomamisege sentle. Koorainadu sarees e ntse e le taba ya bohlokwa bakeng sa ho hlahloba kamano pakeng tsa diaparo, boitsebahatso ba lebatowa, bonono, le bophelo ba mekete Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: Saree ya letseta ya Kovai Kora e amana le Coimbatore le kgaolo ya yone e e dikologileng e e tlhagisang matsela. E dirilwe ka letseta, e anaanelwa ka ntlha ya bontle jwa yone jo bo sa tlhokomelweng, go nna le popego e e phuthologileng le melelwane ya yone e e tlwaelegileng. Fa di bapisiwa le di- saree tsa silika tse di kgabisitsweng thata, gantsi matsela a letseta a Kora a gatelela tsela e letseta le lebegang ka yone ka tlholego, go apara ka tsela e e mosola le dintlha tse di sa bonaleng tsa go dira dilo. Saree e bontsha botlhokwa jwa go lema letseta, go dira tlhale, go loga le kgwebo ya matsela kwa Tamil Nadu. Go tlhagisa saree e e logilweng ka diatla go tlhoka go baakanyetsa ka kelotlhoko ditlhale tsa warp le weft le go dirisa loom ka botswerere. Kora cotton e siametse mefuta e e farologaneng ya ditiragalo, go akaretsa le go apara letsatsi le letsatsi le dikokoano tsa semmuso. Kovai Kora Cotton e ne ya amogelwa ke GI ka 2008.
